messages:
Marta K: Hey — spotted another org's usage showing up on our billing graph after I quick-switched orgs. looks like token counts from Org B appeared in Org A's view.
Daniel H: Repro for me if I switch fast and open the metrics tab.
Eva R: Could be either console not sending org identity, or server cache key missing the org header.
Marta K: Console calls `/internal/metrics?range=7d&...` and we rely on `X-Org` header. query string had no org param when I inspected.
Daniel H: We shipped a fetch optimization that rewrites requests through the edge and it might drop some headers for preflighted / cross-origin requests.
Ryan S: FYI canary flag for related change is out: feature.metrics_proxy_strip_headers at 20% right now.
deploy-bot: canary rollout updated: feature.metrics_proxy_strip_headers -> 20% hosts
Eva R: Also our metrics proxy cache key currently uses only the URL + querystring. If headers get stripped, tenant A can get tenant B's cached response.
Daniel H: Minimal fix: ensure console always adds org in URL param or edge preserves `X-Org`. quick patch idea:

```
// console client
fetch(`/internal/metrics?range=7d&org=${orgId}`, { headers: { 'X-Org': orgId } })

// proxy cache key
const cacheKey = `${req.url}|org=${req.headers['x-org'] || 'anon'}`
```

Marta K: Can we hotfix? This affected billing dashboards for a few customers in the last ~45m.
Daniel H: I'll open a PR to (1) include org in the URL from the client, (2) change proxy to include `X-Org` in cache key, and (3) rollback the canary for the header-strip change.
Ryan S: Also recommend an ops endpoint to invalidate metric caches for the last 2 hours: `/ops/cache/invalidate?prefix=metrics:7d`
Eva R: Add an e2e for quick-switch -> metrics tab asserting the org label and owner tag.
Marta K: Filed incident INC-2026 in #incidents and pinged trust for billing outreach.
Daniel H: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/metrics-proxy/pull/422 — deploying in ~5m to canary group then full rollout if green.
deploy-bot: deploy started: metrics-proxy -> canary
Ryan S: I'll run a query to find dashboards with mismatched owner metadata and flag them for re-eval.
Marta K: Thanks all :thumbsup:
note: thread captures an eng-platform discussion about a multi-tenant metrics cache/header bug and immediate mitigation plan
